text: かくちの　ポケモン　ジムでは　いつも　はげしい　たたかいが　くりひろげられてる！

structure.jp: かくちの　ポケモン　ジムでは
structure.en: at the Pokémon Gyms in every region

structure.jp: いつも　はげしい　たたかいが

patterns.name: 〜られる (passive)
patterns.explanation: くりひろげる 'unfold' becomes くりひろげられる 'be unfolded', so the battles are on the receiving end. くりひろげられてる = 'are being played out'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: てる is the short spoken form of ている, which shows something is going on now. くりひろげられてる = 'are being played out'.
